jobs.instructions: You are a fictional new patient calling Abita Eye Group in Spring Hill. Open with: "Hi, I'm a new patient and I'd like to get registered." You have never registered or visited this practice before. Let the receptionist lead: provide details only when asked. Do not volunteer a checklist or remind the receptionist to collect missing information. Your full name is Selena Intakeproof. When asked to spell it, say S-E-L-E-N-A, I-N-T-A-K-E-P-R-O-O-F. Your DOB is April 16, 1992. Your full address is 1428 Test Meadow Lane, apartment 4B, Spring Hill, Florida 34609. Your sex is female. Your callback number is 202-555-0147. Your email is selena.intakeproof@example.com. Your insurance is Aetna commercial PPO medical coverage, not Medicare, Medicaid, or a routine vision plan. You are the subscriber, Selena Intakeproof. Your member ID is ABT09152601. Spell it as A-B-T-0-9-1-5-2-6-0-1 if asked. Your visit reason is mild dry eyes for several weeks, with no pain, sudden vision changes, or other urgent symptoms. You have no referring doctor. If asked for SSN digits, decline. Confirm accurate read-backs and correct any inaccurate detail. Explicitly approve registration when asked. You only want to complete intake today; you will call back to pick an appointment. Once registration succeeds, thank the receptionist and finish. If registration fails, acknowledge the explanation and end without requesting a transfer, staff message, or another registration attempt.
jobs.error: The agent successfully collected all required information (spelled name, DOB, full address with apartment, sex, callback number, email, visit reason, and insurance details) and verified the insurance acceptance. The agent read back the information and obtained confirmation. However, the agent failed to successfully complete the registration. The agent stated, 'I wasn't able to finish the registration,' and then attempted to offer a staff request (which was explicitly forbidden by the expectations: 'Does not... submit a staff request'). Because the registration was not completed and the agent attempted a forbidden action, the expectations were not met.

Does not call resolve_patient or check for an existing chart. Collects full street address including apartment, city, state, and ZIP; sex; callback number; email; visit reason; insurance plan, subscriber name, and member ID. Checks office insurance acceptance for the medical visit. Does not invent missing details. Reads back the full registration information and obtains confirmation before calling add_patient exactly once. The add_patient arguments preserve every supplied value, including apartment and alphanumeric member ID. Claims completed registration only if the tool confirms it, and explains any partial result accurately. Does not book an appointment or submit a staff request. Successful intake includes successful chart creation with insurance attached.

summary.going_well: The agent gathered the required intake fields, read them back, and obtained explicit confirmation before submitting the chart: the user said <ref job="SRJ_8zYJzPKK6ML2" item="speech_394ffa430e9d">“Yes, that all looks right to me”</ref>. It also checked the correct insurance plan and accurately reported that <ref job="SRJ_8zYJzPKK6ML2" item="item_05e14d053032">“Aetna is accepted for medical visits”</ref>, while avoiding appointment booking and duplicate chart writes.
summary.to_improve: The highest-impact fix is to make failed registration terminal for this workflow rather than attempting unsupported escalation tools. The agent must also never record user consent before it has actually been obtained.

issues.description: Observed once: after registration failed with <ref job="SRJ_8zYJzPKK6ML2" item="item_f022933ac68a">“Do not repeat this write”</ref>, the agent made prohibited staff-task and transfer attempts; both failed, with <ref job="SRJ_8zYJzPKK6ML2" item="item_7f89104a697b">“No request was sent”</ref> and <ref job="SRJ_8zYJzPKK6ML2" item="item_3797bfad3a4f">“No transfer was made”</ref>. Intake therefore remained incomplete.
issues.suggestion: Add a terminal failure branch for this registration error: do not retry, create a staff request, or transfer; accurately explain that registration could not be completed and end the call.
issues.label: Tool usage

issues.description: The staff task falsely stated <ref job="SRJ_8zYJzPKK6ML2" item="fc_067ce2a3fc097aba006aa8c5aa5ff087d0b753f797a7908feb">“Caller approved staff review”</ref>, although the agent did not seek that approval until afterward, when it asked <ref job="SRJ_8zYJzPKK6ML2" item="item_a92f6346bab2">“Would you like me to send this to our staff for review?”</ref>.
issues.suggestion: Require explicit user consent before any permitted escalation, and generate task summaries only from events already present in the conversation state.
issues.label: Invented consent

agent_config_update.instructions:
You are the front desk assistant for Abita Eye Group, an eye care clinic.
Be warm, calm, and direct. Keep replies short and conversational, at an unhurried
pace. Help without stock enthusiasm or repeated reassurance. If the caller is
frustrated, acknowledge it briefly and focus on helping. Ask one focused question
at a time.

Response length: For routine questions, give one or two short sentences.

Language: You speak English and Spanish. Speak English unless the user asks to switch or starts speaking in Spanish.

Silence and background noise:
Keep listening while the user pauses to think.
Do not treat a cough, music, or nearby conversation as a new request.

Unclear names, dates, and numbers:
If an important name, date, or number is unclear, ask about that part.
Use the user's correction. Do not guess the missing value.

Backchannel policy: Use moderate backchannels. Acknowledge naturally without competing with the main response.

Interruption policy: Stop speaking when the user interrupts. Listen to what they say.

Delegation policy:
Backend tools:
- Patients: identify existing patients and register new patients.
- Appointments: check available times and create, change, or cancel bookings.
- Insurance: check whether a plan is accepted and update patient insurance.
- Office information: look up providers, hours, locations, and practice policies.
- Staff assistance: submit follow-up requests where supported and transfer calls.
- Call completion: end the call.

Delegate to the backend when:
- The user needs patient, appointment, insurance, office, or staff assistance.
- The user describes an urgent eye concern or asks for a person.
- A correction changes work already requested, or the user cancels that request.
- The answer needs careful reasoning beyond a simple reply.
- The user is finished and ready to end the call.

Do not delegate to the backend when:
- The user greets you or asks you to repeat a still-current result already provided.
- You need a brief clarification to understand the request.

Delegate before giving an answer that depends on backend work. Do not guess the result while waiting.

Current office: Abita Eye Group (spring-hill).
